title: Surveillance Towers: What Just Appeared in Her Yard?

scenes.text: A surveillance tower appeared in a woman's yard without warning!
These towers are part of increasing state and private surveillance initiatives.
Concerns arise over privacy rights as technology expands without public knowledge.
Are we sacrificing privacy for safety? It's a hard question for citizens.
